The individual should combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and possess a strong understanding of NVOCC economics, carrier dynamics, and global trade flows. Establish and manage strategic partnerships with major container shipping lines and feeder operators. Lead annual, quarterly, and spot negotiations for freight rates, service contracts, capacity commitments, equipment availability, and value-added services. Build a diversified carrier portfolio to optimize cost, service quality, transit times, and risk exposure. Monitor carrier performance and implement corrective actions where service levels fall below expectations. Capacity Procurement & Space Management Secure vessel space and equipment availability across key Global/Regional export and import trade lanes. Negotiate long-term and short-term space agreements to ensure capacity during peak seasons and market disruptions. Develop contingency procurement plans to mitigate risks arising from carrier blank sailings, congestion, capacity shortages, and geopolitical disruptions. Ensure optimal allocation of cargo volumes among contracted carriers. Commercial Support & Pricing Partner closely with Sales and Trade Management teams to support business growth initiatives. Provide competitive procurement solutions for strategic bids, tenders, and key account opportunities. Support pricing teams with market intelligence, carrier rate trends, and capacity outlooks. Drive margin enhancement through effective carrier negotiations and procurement optimization. Market Intelligence & Trade Lane Management Monitor freight market dynamics, carrier strategies, capacity developments, and regulatory changes impacting ocean freight procurement. Analyze market trends and identify opportunities for cost savings, service improvements, and procurement efficiencies. Maintain comprehensive understanding of Global/Major Regional-related trade lanes. Supplier Relationship Management Act as the senior point of contact for carrier management across the Globe/Regions. Conduct regular business reviews with shipping lines to evaluate performance, volume commitments, service quality, and commercial opportunities. Negotiate escalation resolutions related to service failures, capacity constraints, and commercial disputes. Foster strategic partnerships that provide preferential access to capacity and market opportunities. Financial & Performance Management Deliver procurement savings and margin improvement targets. Manage carrier commitments, procurement budgets, and contractual obligations. Develop and monitor procurement KPIs including: o Freight cost optimization o Space utilization o Carrier allocation performance o Service reliability o Equipment availability o Procurement savings o Contract compliance Leadership & Team Management Lead and develop the regional procurement team across the Globe/Regions. Establish procurement governance, processes, and best practices. Coach and mentor procurement professionals to build strong commercial and negotiation capabilities. Promote collaboration across Operations, Trade Management, Pricing, Sales, and Global Procurement teams.
